description:
Powerful and Stable Motor
HITWAY electric bike is equipped with a 750W motor, which can provide strong and stable power for your daily riding. 3 riding modes and Shimano 7-speed gearing for plenty of power for climbing hills or reaching top speed. The top speed of the bike is about 20mph(32km/h), which can meet your commuting and camping needs.
4.0 Inch Tires Conquer Any Terrain
The most dazzling feature of HITWAY BK10M electric bicycle is the 20''×4.0 anti-slip fat tire, which allows you to easily ride on snow, mountain, beach and city roads, bringing you the ultimate riding experience. Coupled with excellent aluminum alloy front fork shock absorption, it can effectively buffer the vibration caused by rough roads and greatly improve riding comfort.
48V 12Ah Battery for Worry-Free Travel
The 48V/12AH detachable rechargeable battery is safe and reliable. It has a maximum cruising range of 20-55mile with continuous pedal assistance, and it will vary according to individual weight and road conditions. BK10M has two charging methods, you can charge this folding electric bike directly, or take out the battery to charge.
Additional Details
The HITWAY urban ebike folds easily and is perfect for storage in your RV, SUV, boat or living space. Smart display's intuitive, readable display shows you speed, battery, distance traveled and more, with head and tail lights illuminating the road at night. High-quality dual disc brakes make your riding safer.
